Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 125. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 15 ki
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Until the start of your next turn.
For the duration of this technique, if you hit a
creature with a weapon/ki attack or technique this turn
it can not make opportunity attacks for the duration.
